sections.title: No new tense needed
sections.content: You've been using the present tense for future plans since Unit 2 (jövő héten...). Weekend plans work exactly the same way: pair a future time word with an ordinary present-tense verb, and it's automatically understood as something you're planning to do, not something happening right now.

items.english: We're having a picnic in the park on Saturday.
We're planning a hike on Sunday.

sections.content: There's no separate future form of kirándulunk to learn here — jövő hétvégén alone does the work of moving the sentence into the future. This is exactly how you already talk about jövő héten and jövő hónapban, just applied to weekend activities.
